scope: Fresh native macOS ARM64 FreeCAD GUI and headless checks of the twenty-patch current-upstream candidate.

runtime.freecad: 27.1.0 dev, source archive has no Git metadata
runtime.qtAndPySide: 6.12.0; one image of each loaded Qt framework. The QtPdf image comes from Homebrew qtwebengine 6.11.2, so this is not a claim of complete cross-component version alignment.

build.description: Fresh Ninja GUI build from the current hash-bound source archive with the five replay-verified candidate files and matching pinned Coin/Pivy/GSL source dependencies; FreeCAD, ImportGui, Import, FreeCADCmd, pivy_coin and Material resources built.
build.sourceReplay: All five affected source and test files match the clean twenty-commit sparse candidate and patch replay.

validation.gui: 67 fixture-free native GUI controls pass with real Draft and ImportGui, including direct and nested 2D/3D geometry, color, layer visibility, malformed input and recovery.
validation.guiUnit: Two downstream GUI tests pass for off-layer ACI color and grouped frozen-layer initial visibility.
validation.headless: Seven focused tests pass for ordinary 2D LINE, DIMENSION, SOLID, classic POLYLINE and layer-boundary controls. An additional strict layer-color syntax test passes.
validation.sandboxNote: Headless tests logged inability to create a user-cache directory under the sandbox, but the assertions completed successfully.

limits: The twenty downstream FreeCAD patches remain unmerged. This is a focused macOS ARM64 candidate build, not full FreeCAD test-suite or release qualification.
Visibility without layer grouping, frozen viewport/block semantics, mixed layers and unsupported geometry/styles remain open.
No pixel-rendering comparison, independent producer/ACIS semantics, Linux/Windows qualification, phase gate or external-only support claim is established.
No FreeCAD source archive, external binaries or drawing fixtures are committed.
